requirements.need: Exact botanical species Pisum sativum (green pea), not chickpea (Cicer arietinum) or common bean (Phaseolus vulgaris). Source must distinguish whole fruit vs cleaned seed.

Numerical thresholds: minimum germination temperature (°C or °F), optimal range, target soil moisture percentage for emergence, and validated soil crust measurement method (penetrometer or visual rating scale).

Source-region specific: temperature in °C/°F with date, soil moisture in % by volume or gravimetric, geography (not Iranian local calendar). Source must be university extension or peer-reviewed journal with original units.
